summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Wetour Robotics Ltd., a foreign private issuer, to furnish a press release dated June 30, 2026. The press release describes a new product demonstration of its Conductor neural wristband, which uses sEMG signals to create real-time 3D hand digital twins and gesture-to-text commands. The filing does not relate to any special situation such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. It is a standard current report on Form 6-K, which is the equivalent of a Form 8-K for US domestic issuers, used to disclose material information that may be of interest to shareholders. No deal terms or special situation dynamics are present.
